Description:  This requirement requires U.S. or foreign flag, self-sustaining Roll-on/Roll-off vessel(s) (multiple awards up to four vessels or until the needs of the government have been met), capable of carrying a minimum of 110,000 SQFT of military cargo (wheeled vehicles, tracked vehicles, and breakbulk) out of a total 426,530 SQFT. Minimum laden speed shall be 15 knots.  
  17. Place of Contract Performance:  The place/range of delivery is Bremerhaven, Germany; and the place/range of redelivery is Corpus Christi, Texas (USA). The layday(s) commences and cancels on 22 June 2026, 26 June 2026, 30 June 2026, and 04 July 2026. Owners/Offerors to indicate estimated time of arrival (ETA) for each layday commencing/cancelling date. Owners/Offerors shall also indicate any layday window they do not want to consider. The period of performance will be about 21 days for each chartered vessel.
  18. Set-aside Status:  N/A. The decision to release this procurement as “Unrestricted” is based on responses received from a recent, sources sought notice for this service.  All responsible sources may submit a proposal, which shall be considered by the agency.  The Small Business Administration’s Procurement Center Representative concurred with this decision.
